semiconductor_relevance: High — Aishengke specializes in high-purity semiconductor materials and CVD/ALD precursor containers, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Aishengke (Jiangsu) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. is a provider of high-purity semiconductor materials and CVD/ALD precursor containers, focusing on technological innovation and stable quality. The company offers customized solutions and adheres to EP-level clean standards, making it a trusted partner for global semiconductor clients.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Changzhou, Jiangsu, focusing on serving global semiconductor clients.
